name: Injury / backup-tier adjusted spread
description: Shift the baseline spread by the measured value of the players officially ruled out, weighted by depth-chart tier (1st/2nd/3rd/4th string).
features: Would need: official status per player, depth-chart order, and an estimated points-per-tiers lot.
